claims.claim: Malaysia has no wealth tax

sources.name: PwC: Malaysia, other taxes
sources.says: Last reviewed 16 June 2026. "There are no net wealth/worth taxes in Malaysia." "There are no inheritance, estate, or gift taxes in Malaysia."

sources.name: PwC: quick chart, net wealth/worth tax rates
sources.says: Headline net wealth/worth tax rate "NA" ("the territory does not have the indicated tax") for Thailand (last reviewed 24 August 2026), Malaysia (16 June 2026), Vietnam (23 September 2026), Indonesia (11 June 2026) and the Philippines (01 August 2026).

claims.claim: Foreign-sourced income received in Malaysia by resident individuals (182+ days) is exempt, subject to conditions, through 31 Dec 2036, so US dividends, interest and loan draws are untaxed locally

sources.name: PwC: Malaysia, income determination
sources.says: Last reviewed 16 June 2026. Foreign-sourced income received in Malaysia by resident individuals "from 1 January 2022 to 31 December 2036 may qualify for tax exemption, subject to conditions" (all classes except partnership income). The 2% tax on "annual dividend income exceeding MYR 100,000 received by resident individuals", from YA 2025: "This tax applies to dividend income distributed by resident companies."

sources.name: PwC: Malaysia, residence
sources.says: Last reviewed 16 June 2026. An individual "in Malaysia for a period or periods amounting to 182 days or more in a calendar year" is generally resident.

claims.note: Searched the exemption with the current month: nothing pending found. PwC does not list the conditions (in the 2024 guidelines they concern income already taxed abroad); a loan is not income, so "loan draws" rides with the claim. The Star (2024) and Bloomberg Tax pages in the profiles were not re-read; PwC is higher in the source order.

sources.name: PwC: Malaysia, other taxes
sources.says: Last reviewed 16 June 2026. "There are no net wealth/worth taxes in Malaysia." "There are no inheritance, estate, or gift taxes in Malaysia."

sources.name: PwC: quick chart, inheritance and gift tax rates
sources.says: Thailand (24 August 2026): inheritance 10, gift 5; Malaysia (16 June 2026): NA, NA; Vietnam (23 September 2026): 10, 10; Indonesia (11 June 2026): NA, NA; Philippines (01 August 2026): "There is no inheritance tax in the Philippines." "an estate tax of 6% is imposed on the assets of the decedent taxpayer."

claims.claim: There is no US estate treaty

sources.name: IRS: Estate & gift tax treaties (international)
sources.says: The table has 15 countries (see us-estate-treaty-list); none of the 37 countries named in this claim is among them.

claims.note: Wording: "there is no US estate treaty, but nothing to double-tax".

claims.claim: US estate tax applies above the $15M exemption (2026): "US estate tax applies only above the $15M exemption (2026)"

sources.name: IRS: What's new, estate and gift tax
sources.says: The table "Basic exclusion amount for year of death" has the row 2026: $15,000,000 (2025: $13,990,000). The page says the Working Families Tax Cuts, Public Law 119-21, signed July 4, 2025, "amends § 2010(c)(3) by increasing the basic exclusion amount to $15,000,000 for calendar year 2026". Page last reviewed or updated 03-Nov-2026.

sources.name: IRS: Estate tax
sources.says: A return is required when the gross estate, plus adjusted taxable gifts and specific exemption, is more than the filing threshold for the year of death; the table gives 2026: $15,000,000. Page last reviewed or updated 23-Oct-2026.

sources.name: IRS news release IR-2025-103: tax inflation adjustments for tax year 2026
sources.says: "Estates of decedents who die during 2026 have a basic exclusion amount of $15,000,000", up from $13,990,000 for 2025; the release (October 9, 2025) cites Revenue Procedure 2025-32 and is marked as an archival document.

sources.name: IRS: Some nonresidents with U.S. assets must file estate tax returns
sources.says: "U.S. citizens are subject to U.S. estate taxation with respect to their worldwide assets"; Form 706 is required when worldwide assets plus adjusted taxable gifts exceed the basic exclusion amount in effect on the date of death. By contrast a nonresident who is not a citizen files when US-situated assets exceed $60,000. Page last reviewed or updated 27-Jun-2026.

sources.says: Dated October 23, 2026. claims.note: Hospital Langkawi and Hospital Sultanah Maliha are the same hospital. The newest pages (2026) describe only the public hospital and calls for a private one; no 2026 report of a private hospital opening was found.
